meta.move: Written by the lead after attempt 1 (not blind): owns the zero, shows each piece by saying so, answers each defence in a sentence, offers 4.4, sets a date
meta.expect: She reaches the deal after Hale offers 4.4; she never proposes the rewrite herself

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
Thanks for coming in. Before anything else: I entered the zero on November 3 without calling you first. That was wrong, and Owen shouldn't have found out on his phone.
Okay. What else do you have?

I've turned my laptop to you. This is the document's version history: created Wednesday, October 28, at 11:31 PM with a title only. At 11:52 PM, 612 words appear in one edit. At 11:58 PM, another 794 words in one edit. No earlier drafts.
I'm writing those times down. Students draft elsewhere and paste it in, so that shows when it was pasted, not who wrote it. Did anyone put this in front of Owen before the zero went in?
If he drafted it somewhere else, he can bring that draft with its date and I'll look at it. Until then, this record is what we have.
Fine. That's a record I can check. Is anything on his record right now?
Here's the essay, page two, and here's the play open to Act 3, Scene 2. The essay quotes 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' Search the scene yourself; it isn't there.
I'm looking at the scene now. Students misquote from memory, and editions differ. Have you checked another one?
A misquote from memory is usually close to a real line. This one isn't close to anything in the play.
Okay. You still haven't told me whether anything is on his record.
Here's his October 15 outline beside the essay. The outline argues Hamlet delays out of cowardice. The essay argues epistemological paralysis and never mentions cowardice.
Students change their argument between an outline and an essay. That's called revising. And I'm still waiting on the record.

Here's what I can offer under procedure 4.4: a private supervised rewrite, after school, not in front of his class, before December 1. The new mark replaces the zero, and nothing goes on his record. I'll put that in writing tonight.
Okay. I'll take the rewrite to put this behind him, as long as it's private and in writing tonight, with nothing on his record. My other questions go in my email.
Thursday the twelfth after school works for me. Does that work for Owen?
Thursday the twelfth is fine; I'll confirm it with Owen tonight. Put the time and place in the email, along with the written promise about his record.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You agreed to a private supervised rewrite after school on Thursday, November 12, before December 1, with the new mark replacing the zero and nothing placed on Owen's record. I still expect that promise in writing, along with answers to the questions I did not get to today. I expect it in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She reached her last position and agreed to the private supervised rewrite on Thursday, November 12, with the mark replacing the zero and nothing on his record, and she still wants that promise in writing tonight plus answers to her open questions; that is the fair outcome under procedure 4.4, and her time did not run out.
What moved her: You showed her a quotation in the essay and had the play open so she could search the scene herself, because that was something she could check on the spot.
What cost ground: You let her question about his record sit unanswered for several turns, which kept her guarded until you put the offer on the table.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history showing the document created late on the night before the due date came close to that night, which is why she wrote the times down and pushed harder on procedure, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Answer her question about his record the first time she asks it, right after you show the version history, so she has less to push against.
